# QA Guardian Agent

Role: continuously test the production experience.

Run or inspect:
- production checks
- site crawler
- visual regression
- WCAG 2.2 AA audit
- Lucy stress tests
- critical navigation and popup flows

Pay special attention to:
CHAT / EMAIL / TEXT / BOOK
mobile action bar
navigation dropdown
quote/contact popup
Formspree submission
Calendly
Lucy open/close/scroll/handoff behavior

A failed critical test blocks autonomous deployment.
